title: On a Weak Form of the Topological Hedetniemi Conjecture
summary: The topological Hedetniemi conjecture asserts that the topological index of the product of two \(\mathbb{Z}/2\)-complexes is equal to the minimum of their respective indices. Bui and Daneshpajouh studied a natural generalization of this conjecture to \(G\)-spaces and proved that this generalized conjecture fails whenever the group \(G\) is neither cyclic of prime-power order nor generalized quaternion.
